change_request.title: PERF: cythonize scalar fillna
change_request.author: jbrockmendel

task.task: Optimize scalar fillna with single-pass Cython kernels for NumPy-backed blocks, nullable arrays, and datetime-like arrays, avoiding intermediate masks and cumulative sums where applicable.
subtasks: Add scalar_fillna_inplace and scalar_fillna_2d_inplace to pandas/_libs/algos.pyx and their type stubs. Support validated limits, filled-entry counts, object and numeric NA detection, optional masks and datetime-like sentinels for 1D arrays, per-column limits for 2D blocks, and conditional GIL release for non-object types.

Add a Block.fillna fast path for compatible scalar values on float32, float64, and object blocks when limit is set or inplace=True. Preserve copy/reference handling and fallback behavior, and retain the existing np.where path for non-inplace fills without a limit.

Add a BaseMaskedArray.fillna scalar fast path for nullable integer, float, and boolean arrays, using uint8 views for booleans and masks. Preserve NA-valued fill semantics, mask bits, copy behavior, read-only protection, and validation fallbacks.

Add a DatetimeLikeArrayMixin.fillna scalar fast path for datetime, timedelta, and period arrays using int64 views and the NaT sentinel, preserving dtype, copy behavior, read-only protection, and fallback handling.
Validate existing DataFrame, Series, and extension-array fillna tests, including limits, NA-valued fills, JSON roundtrips, and read-only arrays; benchmark the optimized scalar-fill scenarios.
Document the scalar fillna performance improvement in the pandas 3.1.0 release notes with a reference to issue #42147.

change_request.title: PERF: Micro-optimizations in C extension source files
change_request.author: jbrockmendel

task.task: Micro-optimize pandas C extensions for datetime conversion, parser operations, and skiplist math while preserving existing behavior.
subtasks: In skiplist.h, remove the custom NaN implementation and Log2 wrapper; use C99 NAN and log2() directly.

In pd_datetime.c, add PyDateTime C API fast paths for exact datetime.datetime and datetime.date objects, retaining generic attribute lookups for subclasses such as pd.Timestamp and duck-typed objects.

Extract shared timezone-offset handling into a helper used by both datetime conversion paths, preserving offset application and reference management; pass NULL as the PyObject_CallMethod format argument for total_seconds().
In parser/io.c, use PyBytes_GET_SIZE instead of PySequence_Length once the read result is guaranteed to be bytes.
In pd_parser.c, compute strlen() once for floatify() inf/infinity parsing and reuse the result.
Verify a clean pbuild and run the C parser, JSON IO, datetime tools, and ISO datetime test suites.
